note: Choose by PAYLOAD CLASS and LATENCY CLASS. A protocol chosen without reference to payload size is a guess.

protocols.name: RTSP
protocols.typical_use: camera to edge node; the standard IP-camera transport

protocols.name: WebRTC
protocols.typical_use: camera or edge to a browser preview; NAT traversal built in

protocols.name: MQTT
protocols.typical_use: small publish/subscribe events; resilience depends on QoS, retries, persistent sessions and broker availability

protocols.name: CoAP
protocols.typical_use: constrained low-power sensor to edge node

protocols.name: HTTPS/REST
protocols.typical_use: HTTP API request/reply; caching depends on methods, headers and endpoint semantics

protocols.name: gRPC
protocols.typical_use: service to service; binary, typed contracts, streaming

protocols.name: HTTPS object storage
protocols.typical_use: rendered assets to storage; resumable upload
